(CLEAR-INPUT <sfa>) sends back an error

;#SFA-|TTY-INPUT|-00000 NOT INPUT FILE

(Don't panic - I just don't remember what went in the 00000 slot) ...
(SFA-GET <sfa> 'WHICH-OPERATIONS) doesn't list CLEAR-INPUT even tho'
(SFA-CALL <sfa> 'WHICH-OPERATIONS ()) does.

I might note that this same discrepency between (SFA-GET <sfa> 'W-O)
and (SFA-CALL <sfa> 'W-O ()) exists for the already complained about
case of FILEMODE.
